name: Exp_PA_Oscillator
summary: This EA trades based on the PA_Oscillator custom indicator, which uses dual smoothing of price data to generate momentum-based buy and sell signals. It opens buy positions when the oscillator crosses above zero and sell positions when it crosses below a threshold, with configurable position closing on signal reversal. The EA supports multiple smoothing algorithms and applied price types for flexible signal generation.
summary_zh: 该EA基于PA_Oscillator自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用双重平滑算法处理价格数据以生成动量买卖信号。当振荡器上穿零轴时开多仓，下穿阈值时开空仓，并在信号反转时可配置平仓。支持多种平滑算法和应用价格类型。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于PA_Oscillator振荡器的动量信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为：当振荡器缓冲区1的值从0上穿时（Col[1]==0且Col[0]>0），触发买入信号；当缓冲区1的值从2下穿时（Col[1]==2且Col[0]<2），触发卖出信号。出场条件依赖信号反转：买入信号出现时同时触发卖出平仓，卖出信号出现时同时触发买入平仓，且可通过BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数独立控制。仓位管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金或固定手数四种模式计算仓位。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），MMMode参数选择资金管理模式，同时设有1000点止损和2000点止盈进行风险控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum signals generated by the PA_Oscillator indicator, which applies dual smoothing (configurable methods like EMA, JJMA, JurX, T3, VIDYA, AMA, etc.) to price data. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the oscillator's buffer 1 crosses above zero (Col[1]==0 and Col[0]>0), while a sell signal triggers when buffer 1 crosses below the threshold of 2 (Col[1]==2 and Col[0]<2). Exit conditions rely on signal reversal: a buy signal simultaneously triggers sell position closure, and a sell signal triggers buy position closure, each independently controllable via BuyPosClose and SellPosClose parameters. Position sizing is handled through TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions supporting four margin modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-free-margin-based, and fixed lot sizing. Money management uses the MM parameter (default 0.1) for risk proportion and MMMode for margin calculation mode, supplemented by a 1000-point stop loss and 2000-point take profit for risk control.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter for lot calculation

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin / balance / margin after loss / balance after loss / fixed lot

pros: 支持多达10种平滑算法和9种价格类型，策略灵活性高
买卖开仓和平仓信号可独立控制，便于策略优化和回测
设有止损止盈和滑点控制，具备基本风险管理框架
使用IsNewBar进行新bar检测，避免同一K线内重复交易
资金管理支持多种模式，适应不同风险偏好
pros_en: Supports up to 10 smoothing algorithms and 9 applied price types for high strategy flexibility
Buy/sell open and close signals are independently controllable, facilitating strategy optimization and backtesting
Includes stop loss, take profit, and slippage control providing a basic risk management framework
Uses IsNewBar for new bar detection to prevent duplicate trades within the same candle
Money management supports multiple modes accommodating different risk preferences
cons: 依赖自定义指标PA_Oscillator的外部文件，缺乏指标源码则无法验证信号逻辑
止损1000点和止盈2000点偏大，在小周期交易中可能导致过大亏损
缺少加仓、移动止损和追踪止损功能，盈利能力受限
信号逻辑简单（仅基于缓冲区值0和2的交叉），在震荡行情中可能频繁假信号
没有 spread 过滤或交易时段过滤，可能在不利条件下开仓
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator PA_Oscillator file; signal logic cannot be verified without its source code
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large, potentially causing excessive losses on smaller timeframes
Lacks position adding, trailing stop, and breakeven functionality limiting profit potential
Signal logic is simplistic (based only on buffer value crossings at 0 and 2), likely generating frequent false signals in ranging markets
No spread filter or trading session filter, may open positions under unfavorable conditions
improvements: 添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高成本时段交易
增加移动止损和保本功能，提高盈利交易的收益保护
添加震荡/趋势市场识别过滤器，减少震荡行情中的假信号
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid trading during high-cost periods
Add trailing stop and breakeven functionality to better protect profits on winning trades
Add trend/range market identification filter to reduce false signals in sideways markets

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下可能导致滑点损失
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化
依赖外部指标文件，若指标加载失败则EA无法运行但未做充分容错
risk_points_en: No spread filter; high spread environments may cause slippage losses
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not account for market volatility changes
Depends on external indicator file; insufficient error handling if indicator fails to load
